messages:
maria.g: Heads up — SCIM sync to AcmeCorp started failing ~10:30 UTC. Provisioner gets 403 from their IdP, then our side logs a KMS decrypt error. Any ideas?

ashok.k: seeing the same in monitoring. A bunch of 403s then retries. KMS errors look like: 
```
ERROR: kms/decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: decryption failed for key arn:aws:kms:...
context: provisioner/scim/txn=42 user=acme/jdoe
```

dylan-r: can you paste the SAML/OIDC token header from the request? wondering if IdP rotated keys or changed alg.

maria.g: grabbing logs. here's the assertion signature header we got from the IdP (jwt header): 
```
{"alg":"RS256","kid":"old-key-2022","typ":"JWT"}
```
but our JWK cache only has `kid: acme-key-2026` and `kid: backup-1`.

irene: hmm. acme said they rotated keys earlier today but their metadata endpoint still lists the new key. Do we have a lag in JWK refresh?

ashok.k: our JWK cache TTL is 5m, but there's an extra in-memory cache in the provisioner that had a 1h ttl. looks like the provisioner didn't refresh after a rotate. I'll push a hotfix to invalidate that cache.

maria.g: while that would explain 403s for signature verification, why KMS decrypt errors? those happen when we try to fetch SCIM secrets for tenant and decrypt them. Could be a concurrent side effect from retries.

oncall-sre: tagging to triage. @oncall-sre looking at network egress to KMS now. no obvious throttling. KMS API count is normal, but error rate spikes match the 403 window.

dylan-r: possible sequence: failed token verification -> provisioner treats token as unauthenticated -> tries fallback key path which uses a different encrypted secret or wrong context -> KMS rejects with InvalidCiphertext. We should correlate request IDs. Can someone grep the provisioner logs for trace_id X?

maria.g: grep done. trace_id 8f3a shows: 
```
[08:30:11] received assertion kid=old-key-2022
[08:30:11] verify_jwt: kid not found -> attempt remote jwk fetch -> got new key but local cache still had old -> verify failed -> return 403
[08:30:11] fallback-secrets: load secret tenant=acme env=prod -> decrypt attempt -> KMS InvalidCiphertextException
```

ashok.k: pushed cache invalidation to provisioner canary (2 pods). rolling out to the rest now. will add a short-term mitigation to log more context for decrypt attempts.

irene: also reached out to Acme IdP to confirm they actually rotated and whether they temporarily served both keys. they replied: "we rotated keys at 08:28 UTC and we still sign with old-key for a 2-minute overlap". so the timeline fits.

maria.g: great. action items: 1) ashok deploys full invalidation, 2) dylan add better correlation between verify and decrypt error logs, 3) irene confirm Acme will extend overlap window next time. any objections?

dylan-r: also recommend we add a check in our provisioning pipeline to verify JWKs match before using cached secrets; if mismatch, do an immediate cache refresh and delay processing by ~500ms to avoid decrypting with stale context. I'll open a GH issue.

ashok.k: rolled invalidation to all pods at 08:47. errors dropped to baseline by 08:50. keeping an eye. :thumbsup:

maria.g: closing the incident once metrics are stable for 30m. thanks all. :sparkles:

samops-bot: Incident noted: ENGSEC-2026-233. Postmortem owner assigned: ashok.k
